name: pavanamuktasana yoga pose
description: The wind-relieving pose, where you hug your knees to your chest while lying down. It stretches the hips and lower back.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight.
Bend your knees and draw them into your chest.
Wrap your arms around your shins and hug them in.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed on the floor.
Breathe slowly and hold for 20-30 seconds.
